name: Solenne Atelier Voidborn Couture Exo-Mantle
description:
Designer Ifeoma Solenne's singular statement piece for the 2200 Spire Ascension collection: a structural shoulder mantle constructed from lab-grown black coral polymer over a frame of articulated titanium filament, draped with 11 meters of hand-pleated bioluminescent silk-analog that shifts between deep indigo and cold white in response to the wearer's body heat. The chest panel is set with 34 polished synthetic opals sourced from off-site orbital fabrication. Gene-compatible openings accommodate horn placement up to 40cm and allow full tail articulation through a hidden rear cascade panel.

One garment exists. It was commissioned by a Spire power broker whose name is not publicly attached to the piece.
functionality: Thermal-responsive bioluminescent silk shifts color without power draw. Titanium frame is load-bearing enough to support the full mantle weight without resting on the wearer's shoulders. Concealed rear cascade opens on magnetic release for full tail and geneware clearance.
what_it_says: Whoever wears this spent more on a single garment than most the Gray Zone residents see in a lifetime, and they want every room to know it.
story_hooks: The mantle was stolen the night of its first public wearing — the buyer refuses to involve CorpSec and is handling recovery privately.
Ifeoma Solenne built a tracker into the coral polymer frame without the commissioner's knowledge, and she's been watching where it goes.
A the Gray Zone artist releases a hand-painted replica that's going viral — the Solenne legal team's response is disproportionate enough to suggest the original holds something more than fabric.

physical_description.visual_profile: A dramatic architectural statement piece that transforms the wearer into a living sculpture. The structured black coral polymer shoulder mantle creates an imposing, almost otherworldly silhouette that frames the upper body like a predator's carapace. The cascading bioluminescent silk-analog creates an ethereal counterpoint—11 meters of fabric flowing from shoulders to ankles in precise pleats that seem to glow from within. The synthetic opal chest panel catches light like a constellation map. Designed for someone augmented with horns and tail, it reads as simultaneously alien, aristocratic, and deeply personal.
physical_description.fit: Dramatically structured at the shoulders and chest, flowing loose through the body. The titanium filament frame maintains rigid architectural geometry at the shoulders while allowing the pleated silk to move with the wearer's body. Built with ergonomic accommodations for non-standard augmentations—horn and tail apertures are invisible when not in use but precisely positioned for full articulation.
physical_description.primary_material: Lab-grown black coral polymer structural frame, articulated titanium filament skeleton, hand-pleated bioluminescent silk-analog, 34 synthetic opals from orbital fabrication
physical_description.texture: The coral polymer is smooth and organic-looking despite its synthetic origin, almost chitinous. The pleated silk has a crisp geometric texture that softens with movement. The synthetic opals are cut and polished to mirror-brightness, creating tactile points of reflection across the chest.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep matte black coral with structural silver titanium visible at articulation points. The silk-analog shifts between indigo and cold white depending on body heat—cooler tones in cold environments, brighter whites as the wearer's temperature rises. The synthetic opals provide intermittent brilliant white sparkle across the chest panel.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snaps integrated into the titanium frame at shoulder points; the rear cascade panel (for tail articulation) uses friction-fit magnetic closure that appears seamless when fastened
distinctive_features: 34-opal chest constellation panel—each opal individually set and polished
11 meters of hand-pleated bioluminescent silk—each pleat a precise geometric fold
Articulated titanium filament frame visible at structural joints—functional art
Gene-compatible horn apertures (accommodates up to 40cm augmentation)
Hidden rear cascade panel for full tail articulation
Thermochromic silk-analog that shifts indigo-to-white with body heat
Organic black coral polymer—lab-grown but mimics natural growth patterns
Zero branding—Solenne Atelier does not apply logos to singular commissions
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1 luxury—but with a Tier 5 soul. Commissioned by wealth, created by hunger. This is haute couture for the augmented, the different, the unapologetically other.
physical_description.cultural_context: Wearing this announces several truths simultaneously: you are augmented in visible ways (horns, tail, or both). You have access to resources that can commission bespoke pieces from underground designers. You are comfortable being visibly *different*—this piece celebrates augmentation rather than hiding it. In the GLMZ, this signals someone who has rejected corpo conformity while retaining enough wealth/power to do so safely. Worn by someone who can afford to be *exactly* themselves.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine. This is a singular piece—it exists in singular condition. Each wearing marks it slightly (microabrasions on opal facets, thermal memory in the silk folds), but it is treated as the art object it is. The wearer likely has it professionally maintained.
